Thank you for your interest in contributing! Until the 1.0.0 evaluation, the version measured must be
the one the article describes, so a pull request may touch only:

- the interface (`web/`, `anchor/ui/`) and its server;
- the automations' storage (`anchor/automations/`, without changing how a saved automation runs).

It must not touch the engine (`anchor/engine/`, `anchor/agent/`, `anchor/planner/`), the evaluation
(`eval/`) or its closed sets. Lucas reviews and merges every pull request.

Before a larger change, [open an issue](https://github.com/LucasDantas2701/ANCHOR/issues/new/choose)
or a discussion to agree on it first.
